description.value: Bert Flinn Park is a nature reserve in Port Moody, BC, offering natural green space within an urban area. It is managed by the City of Port Moody and provides trail access through forested terrain. Touring cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area may find it a worthwhile stop for a natural respite.
